faq.q: How does local image compression work?
faq.a: CoolTools leverages the browser's native HTML5 Canvas API to serialize image buffers at a customized quality level (0.01 to 1.00). Processing happens entirely in-browser sandbox.

faq.q: Will my image format be changed?
faq.a: No. The compressor maintains your source format (PNG, JPEG, WebP) by default, though PNG files are compressed as JPEGs or optimized WebPs for maximum file size reduction.
